citation: Roberts‐Thomson KM, Parker L, Betik AC, et al. Oral and intravenous glucose administration elicit opposing microvascular blood flow responses in skeletal muscle of healthy people: role of incretins. The Journal of Physiology. 2022.
protocol: 75 g OGTT (visit 1; samples 0,5,10,15,20,30,40,50,60,80,90,100,110,120 min) vs variable-rate 10% IV glucose infusion over 120 min (IVGTT) matched to the OGTT glucose excursion (visit 2, 1-4 weeks later); 12 h overnight fast
note: Rare: haemodynamics (HR, BP) alongside oral vs IV glucose in healthy adults. Glucose and insulin time courses are figures with AUCs in text. No order randomisation (OGTT first). Table 4 also has PYY.
